column3: “A violent death” renders the deaths of the slain.
The killer is plural rather than singular; hands renders singular hand.
“Seal of perfection” renders one sealing a measure.
“Mountings and settings” renders the two crafted objects; gold is attached to their workmanship rather than listed with the stones.
The filling by others is rendered passively; driving in disgrace renders profaning from the mountain, and banishing renders destroying from among the stones.
“Spectacle” specifies being set before kings to be seen.
“All the nations who know you” replaces all who know you among the peoples; a horrible end renders become terrors.
“People of Israel” renders house of Israel.
